Name: Potion of Healing
Description: A bitter red liquid that mends wounds.

Name: Boots of Speed
Description: Put these on and run for the hills.

Name: Choking Dust
Description: One pinch of this will knock anyone out.

Name: Medal of Fire
Description:
A golden medal with a fiery crest.
Grants the wearer immunity to fire.

Name: Bloody Hand
Description: A living gauntlet that rends flesh.

Name: Wand of Light
Description: This this wand emits a bright light.

Name: -2 Dagger
Description: This cursed weapon makes it's weilder clumsy and slow.

Name: Slaying Arrow
Description: One prick from this arrow is enough to fell a giant.

Name: Screaming Bolt
Description: Lets out a horrible yell as it flies.

Name: Le Excuse
Description:
A long, flat playing card depicting a wandering minstrel.
Something about this is magical, but you can't put your finger on it.

Name: Wormwood Flute
Description: The music from this flute has the ability to charm insects of all shapes and sizes.

Name: Mummified Head
Description:
The cursed head of a powerful goblin leader.
Anyone who looks into its eyes is cursed for eons...

Name: Helm of Telepathy
Description:
This ornate helmet lets you read the thoughts of others as if they were your own.
Sort of invasive, no?

Name: Ice Boots
Description: Water freezes at the wearer's touch, allowing them to skate across rivers and oceans.
